arxiv-2011-07509.title: Automated Intersection Management with MiniZinc PubID: pubid: 978-1-7281-9576-6/20/$31.00 ©2020 IEEE
arxiv-2011-07509.creator: Md. Mushfiqur Rahman 1 , Nahian Muhtasim Zahin 2 , Kazi Raiyan Mahmud 3 , Md. Azmaeen Bin Ansar 4
arxiv-2011-07509.description: Abstract Ill-managed intersections are the primary reasons behind the increasing traffic problem in urban areas, leading to nonoptimal traffic-flow and unnecessary deadlocks. In this paper, we propose an automated intersection management system that extracts data from a well-defined grid of sensors and optimizes traffic flow by controlling traffic signals.

arxiv-2210-12135.title: Geometric Sparse Coding in Wasserstein Space
arxiv-2210-12135.creator: Marshall Mueller, Shuchin Aeron, James M. Murphy, Abiy Tasissa
arxiv-2210-12135.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marshall Mueller, Shuchin Aeron, James M. Murphy, Abiy Tasissa. Wasserstein dictionary learning is an unsupervised approach to learning a collection of probability distributions that generate observed distributions as Wasserstein barycentric combinations. Existing methods for Wasserstein dictionary learning optimize an objective that seeks a dictionary with sufficient representation capacity via barycentric interpolation to approximate the observed training data, but without imposing additional structural properties on the coefficients associated to the dictionary.

arxiv-2501-09093.title: TeV afterglow emission from a structured GRB jet using the kinetic approach 2023 TeV afterglow emission from a structured GRB jet using the kinetic approach – C
arxiv-2501-09093.creator: John P. Hope, Hendrik J. van Eerten, Sayan Kundu, Patricia Schady
arxiv-2501-09093.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by John P. Hope, Hendrik J. van Eerten, Sayan Kundu, Patricia Schady. Recent years have seen a growing sample of TeV emission detections in gamma-ray burst afterglows, as well as an increasing role for structured jets in afterglow modelling. Using a kinetic approach, we show that the structure of an afterglow jet impacts its TeV emission, with jets where the energy falls off more sharply with angle showing a decrease in Inverse Compton (IC) peak flux relative to synchrotron peak flux.

arxiv-2504-11857.creator: Renjin Jiang, Tianjun Shen, Sibei Yang & Houkun Zhang
arxiv-2504-11857.description: Abstract Abstract . In this paper, we derive sharp two side heat kernel estimate on exterior C^{1,1} domains in the plane, and sharp upper heat kernel bound on exterior C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}} domains in \mathbb{R}^{n} , n\geq 2 . Estimates for Green’s function and Riesz potentials on exterior domains in the plane are also presented.

arxiv-2506-05069.title: Reason-to-Recommend: Using Interaction-of-Thought Reasoning to Enhance LLM Recommendation
arxiv-2506-05069.creator: Keyu Zhao, Fengli Xu, Yong Li
arxiv-2506-05069.description: Abstract Driven by recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), their integration into recommendation tasks has attracted growing interest, owing to their strong semantic understanding and prompt-based flexibility. Prior studies have encoded user–item interactions or metadata into prompts to enable recommendations.

arxiv-2506-16388.title: HausaNLP at SemEval-2025 Task 11: Hausa Text Emotion Detection
arxiv-2506-16388.creator: Sani Abdullahi Sani, Salim Abubakar, Falalu Ibrahim Lawan, Abdulhamid Abubakar, Maryam Bala
arxiv-2506-16388.description: Abstract This paper presents our approach to multi-label emotion detection in Hausa, a low-resource African language, for SemEval Track A. We fine-tuned AfriBERTa, a transformer-based model pre-trained on African languages, to classify Hausa text into six emotions: anger, disgust, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise. Our methodology involved data preprocessing, tokenization, and model fine-tuning using the Hugging Face Trainer API.

arxiv-2510-26001.title: Larger Hausdorff Dimension in Scanning Pattern Facilitates Mamba-Based Methods in Low-Light Image Enhancement Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2510-26001.creator: Xinhua Wang, Caibo Feng, Xiangjun Fu, Chunxiao Liu
arxiv-2510-26001.description: Abstract . In the domain of low-light image enhancement, both transformer-based approaches, such as Retinexformer and Mamba-based frameworks, such as MambaLLIE, have demonstrated distinct advantages alongside inherent limitations. Transformer-based methods, in comparison with mamba-based methods, can capture local interactions more effectively, albeit often at a high computational cost.

pmc-10774658.creator: Devi Nair, Martin Martinek, B. Judson Colley, Sri Sundaram, Ramesh Hariharan, Gustavo Morales, Philipp Sommer, Stewart Healy, Usman Siddiqui, Douglas Gibson, Kristina Chapman, Anne Sarver, Monica Lo
pmc-10774658.description: BackgroundCatheter ablation is an established therapy for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF). The TactiFlex Ablation Catheter, Sensor Enabled (TactiFlex SE) is a next-generation radiofrequency ablation catheter incorporating fiber optics-based contact force–sensing technology with a flexible, laser-cut tip.ObjectiveThe study sought to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the TactiFlex SE ablation catheter for treatment of drug-refractory PAF.

pmc-11341871.title: Iron-catalyzed radical Markovnikov hydrohalogenation and hydroazidation of alkenes
pmc-11341871.creator: Jonas Elfert, Nils Lennart Frye, Isabel Rempel, Constantin Gabriel Daniliuc, Armido Studer
pmc-11341871.description: We herein report radical hydroazidation and hydrohalogenation of mono-, di- and trisubstituted alkenes through iron catalysis. The alkene moiety that often occurs as a functionality in natural products is readily transformed into useful building blocks through this approach. Commercially available tosylates and α-halogenated esters are used as radical trapping reagents in combination with silanes as reductants.

pmc-11692418.title: ROLE OF MACHINE LEARNING (ML) IN AGING IN PLACE RESEARCH: A SCOPING REVIEW
pmc-11692418.creator: Sojung Park, Eunhye Ahn, Tae-Hyuk Ahn, SangNam Ahn, Soobin Park, Eunsun Kwon, Seoyeon Ahn, Yuanyuan Yang
pmc-11692418.description: As global aging accelerates, Aging in Place (AIP) is increasingly central to improving older adults’ quality of life. Machine Learning (ML) is widely used in aging research, particularly in health monitoring and personalized care. However, most studies focus on clinical settings, leaving a gap in understanding ML’s application in non-clinical AIP contexts.

pmc-11714077.title: Investigation of structural connectivity in the whole brain and frontoparietal network in groups at risk of Alzheimer’s disease dementia
pmc-11714077.creator: Lenore T Tahara‐Eckl, Catherine A Morgan, Reece P Roberts, Flavio Dell'Acqua, Ian J Kirk, Tracy R Melzer, John C Dalrymple‐Alford, Tim J Anderson, Nicholas J Cutfield, Lynette J Tippett
pmc-11714077.description: BackgroundBrain connectivity patterns, measured with Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), have been recently studied as a potential biomarker for Alzheimer’s disease dementia (AD). A ‘disconnected brain’ has been associated with greater cognitive impairment in pathological aging (Bennett & Madden, 2014), but it is unclear how this occurs in groups at risk of AD.

pmc-12615162.title: Impact of pretransplant vitamin D deficiency on immune recovery and clinical outcomes in multiple myeloma patients undergoing autologous stem cell transplantation
pmc-12615162.creator: Amany R. Keruakous, Nabil Ghani, Shreya Desai, Christopher Terrell, Shahrzad Zamani, Linda Youn, Sindu Iska, Mai Keruakous, Zhu Cui
pmc-12615162.description: This study examines the impact of pretransplant vitamin D deficiency on immune recovery and clinical outcomes in multiple myeloma patients undergoing autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT). Given vitamin D’s known immunomodulatory effects, the research describes its influence on neutrophil and platelet engraftment, lymphocyte recovery, and overall response rates post-ASCT.

pmc-13241382.description: Study DesignProspective observational cohort study.ObjectiveStandard postoperative follow-up often fails to capture rapid fluctuations in symptoms after degenerative lumbar spine surgery. pmc-13416627.creator: Md Jahidul Alam, Zannatul Mawa Koli, Labony Sur, Zahara Al Zarin, Most Hasna Hena, Tapasy Rabeya
pmc-13416627.description: BanglaVoice is a curated sentence-level dataset for grammatical voice analysis in Bangla, comprising 4397 annotated sentences categorized as Active (1459), Passive (1531), and Middle (1407). Each instance consists of a structurally complete clause containing a single dominant finite verb, accompanied by its English translation and a categorical voice label.

pmc-13643964.title: Quadriceps recovery after subvastus total knee arthroplasty in valgus deformity: a systematic review and pooled descriptive analysis
pmc-13643964.creator: Hifza Babar, Yu Zhang, Qiangqiang Li, Dongyang Chen, Zezhang Zhu
pmc-13643964.description: BackgroundThe subvastus approach preserves the extensor mechanism, but its efficacy in total knee arthroplasty (TKA) for valgus deformity remains unclear. This systematic review synthesizes available evidence on quadriceps recovery and clinical outcomes after subvastus TKA specifically in patients with valgus deformity.MethodsA systematic search of PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Embase (2000–2025) was performed.
